entities.summary:
﻿
Ann Mather is an English business executive. She is on the boards of directors of Netflix, Bumble, Pattern, Aible, and Blend. Her prior board experience includes Alphabet, Airbnb, Arista Networks, MGM Studios and Zappos. Mather was executive vice president and chief financial officer of Pixar Studios from September 1999 to April 2004, reporting to Steve Jobs.
